_about: CI emulator baseline (API 34 x86_64, 6 GB, 256 MB heap growth limit), NOT a device. Each metric is the median of three runs of near-identical code on shared runners: a1c059b (run 41361377483; its TTFD from 41358849555), and 6415bf2 twice (runs 41364011716 and 41364018233), so no one runner's speed sets it. Counts are from a1c059b. perf_report.py fails only a gated (central) metric past 2x this and its noise floor; tail metrics are reported, not gated. Refresh with --write-baseline on a green run's perf-results.json (better: the median of several) and say why in the commit.
